description: This file defines a Java interface for building responses to 'RetrieveFeature' commands within a live signals command framework. The interface specifies methods for creating response objects, including successful retrievals and error responses.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building responses to 'RetrieveFeature' commands, supporting query command response steps.

methods.name: ResponseFactory
methods.description: Nested interface defining methods to create response objects, such as successful feature retrievals and error responses.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveFeatureResponse containing the retrieved feature.

methods.name: featureNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature does not exist or is not accessible, for permission issues.
